tool_args.rationale: The prior attempt failed because its prediction code referenced an undefined train_rows variable. This version fits the three guided siphon parameters numerically from the paid rows and stores them for subsequent row-wise prediction; all observed gradients are subcritical.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available rows span u_now and s_grad, and the supplied branch guidance selects the sqrt branch; the model can be fit directly without a probe.
All rows share H=0.6 and provided guidance identifies a reduced slow-ODE base; extra trajectory resolution is not needed for this model.
All observed s_grad values are below 2.36, so the stated high-gradient probe condition and supercritical term do not apply.
It omits the observed s_grad dependence and does not match the supplied shared-base subtree guidance.
